note: One record per tracker row. buyers lists the companies behind buyer_label; tools that need one row per buyer split on it.

deals.headline: $150M up, $12B+
deals.summary: Multi-year AI drug discovery across neuroscience and oncology. $500M+ cumulative milestones achieved.
deals.signal: Pharma increasingly outsources biological data generation to AI-native platforms.
deals.platform_about: Clinical-stage TechBio. Recursion OS combines automated biology, chemistry, and ML.

deals.headline: Up to $2.56B
deals.summary: Up to $2.56B for AI-driven bispecific antibody discovery across autoimmune and inflammatory diseases.
deals.signal: Sanofi repeatedly returning to an AI-native biologics platform — a repeat discovery partner.
deals.platform_about: AI-powered biotech focused on next-generation biologics.

deals.headline: $45M up / $1.7B milestones
deals.summary: Multi-target drug discovery using Isomorphic's AI-first drug design engine.
deals.signal: A structural shift from AI-as-tooling to AI-native drug creation.
deals.platform_about: Google DeepMind spinout. Raised $2.1B Series B in May 2026.

deals.headline: 50+ programmes
deals.summary: Protein-engineering platform running 50+ R&D programs across 6+ of the top 25 pharma.
deals.signal: AI making therapeutic molecules easier to build, optimise, and manufacture.
deals.platform_about: Enterprise-grade AI for protein engineering.

deals.headline: $50M up + milestones
deals.summary: Licensed OCTO-VC spatial-biology foundation models for lung and colorectal cancer. First near-term milestone achieved (Aug 2026): OCTO-VC inference and fine-tuning deployed and in use by GSK for virtual-cell experiments and patient stratification.
deals.signal: Hitting the first milestone fast validates the subscription-style 'foundation-model-as-asset' model — GSK pays for ongoing access to a continuously improving virtual-cell platform, not a single molecule.
deals.platform_about: AI foundation models on spatial biology and multimodal oncology data. Builder of the OCTO-VC virtual-cell foundation models.

deals.headline: 250+ AI tools
deals.summary: Technology partner for Lilly TuneLab 2.0, providing infrastructure for biomolecular AI.
deals.signal: The bottleneck may be deployment, governance, and workflow integration.
deals.platform_about: Infrastructure and workflow software for computational biology.

deals.headline: $12M seed
deals.summary: Emerged from stealth with $12M seed and production deployments across top pharma.
deals.signal: From standalone AI tools to AI operating systems orchestrating enterprise decisions.
deals.platform_about: AI operating system for the drug development lifecycle.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: AZ acquired Modella AI — big pharma acquiring an AI-native company rather than licensing.
deals.signal: From partnership to ownership in six months.
deals.platform_about: Biomedical AI company building multimodal foundation models for oncology.

deals.headline: 1,016 GPUs
deals.summary: LillyPod: DGX SuperPOD AI factory powered by 1,016 Blackwell Ultra GPUs.
deals.signal: Lilly treats AI infrastructure as strategic capability.
deals.platform_about: NVIDIA accelerated computing for AI training and inference.

deals.headline: 3,500+ GPUs
deals.summary: 2,176 Blackwell GPUs added, total 3,500+ — largest announced GPU footprint in pharma.
deals.signal: Roche assembling the broadest AI drug-development stack in industry.
deals.platform_about: NVIDIA accelerated computing across Roche R&D and diagnostics.

deals.headline: $115M up, $2.75B+
deals.summary: Exclusive worldwide license to AI-designed preclinical oral therapeutics. Third Lilly-Insilico deal.
deals.signal: Escalation: software licensing → collaboration → $2.75B asset-and-platform partnership.
deals.platform_about: End-to-end AI drug discovery with clinical-stage programmes.

deals.headline: Up to $1B
deals.summary: Deploying Gemini Enterprise across 75,000 employees — R&D, manufacturing, commercial.
deals.signal: AI agents in GxP-regulated workflows create novel compliance questions.
deals.platform_about: Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise with embedded engineers.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Integrating OpenAI across discovery, manufacturing, supply chain. Full integration by end 2026.
deals.signal: Multi-vendor strategy: Azure + NVIDIA + OpenAI, hedging against lock-in.
deals.platform_about: OpenAI enterprise platform across pharmaceutical operations.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Multimodal biomarker discovery and response prediction in oncology.
deals.signal: Companion diagnostics becoming competitive requirements for ADC leaders.
deals.platform_about: Precision oncology AI using CanvOI model and 3.5M+ tissue samples.

deals.headline: 3-year deal
deals.summary: 3-year licensing for Owkin's AI Scientist platform — hypothesis generation and research support.
deals.signal: Agentic AI participating in scientific workflow.
deals.platform_about: French AI biotech developing agentic AI Scientist platform.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Claude deployed across 30,000+ BMS employees — discovery, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing.
deals.signal: Claude Code in engineering, AI agents in R&D/manufacturing, root-cause investigations in GxP.
deals.platform_about: Anthropic's Claude as enterprise intelligence platform.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Deploying Kosmos AI scientist platform across Incyte's discovery lifecycle.
deals.signal: Emerging 'AI scientist' category. Outcomes will matter more than capabilities.
deals.platform_about: AI platform for scientific R&D decisions and workflows.

deals.headline: Up to $16M
deals.summary: Third expansion of Sanofi-CytoReason collaboration for computational disease models.
deals.signal: Repeated expansion: renewals are stronger validation than headline-grabbing first deals.
deals.platform_about: AI computational disease models across genes, pathways, cells.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Chai-3 access plus custom model trained on Pfizer's proprietary data.
deals.signal: Competitive advantage from proprietary fine-tuning, not the generic model.
deals.platform_about: AI models for molecular design. Developer of Chai-3. Raised $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation (Jul 2026, Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia). ~$630M total raised.

deals.headline: Multi-year
deals.summary: Refining Boltz foundation models on Pfizer data for structure prediction and biologics.
deals.signal: Open-source model + proprietary fine-tuning entering molecular biology.
deals.platform_about: Public benefit corp building open-source biomolecular AI models.

deals.headline: Up to $510M
deals.summary: Multi-target discovery collaboration combining Protillion's Prot-MaP platform with Merck.
deals.signal: High-quality experimental data becoming as important as algorithms.
deals.platform_about: Lab-in-the-loop AI drug design. Megascale training datasets.

deals.headline: $120M+
deals.summary: Target discovery and license agreement for cardiorenal and kidney disease.
deals.signal: AI-driven target discovery meets genetically validated drug targets.
deals.platform_about: Genomics-driven AI. Proprietary data from diverse populations.

deals.headline: $120M up; $1B+
deals.summary: Expanded AI collaboration adding 5+ targets. Incyte shares proprietary data to train GEMS.
deals.signal: Pharma using internal datasets as differentiating assets in AI partnerships.
deals.platform_about: Generative and predictive foundation models. GEMS platform.

deals.headline: $37.5M up, $1.2B
deals.summary: Strategic collaboration for small-molecule therapeutics. Expanded February 2025.
deals.signal: First to validate Isomorphic's AI-native co-development model.
deals.platform_about: Google DeepMind spinout. AI-first drug design engine.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Cross-modality, multi-target collaboration expanding into biologics design.
deals.signal: Isomorphic evolving from structure prediction into broader molecular design.
deals.platform_about: DeepMind spinout. J&J extends into biologics.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Biologics discovery using Chai's AI, expanded through Lilly's TuneLab platform.
deals.signal: From 'best model' to 'strongest AI-enabled discovery network.'
deals.platform_about: AI models for molecular design. Developer of Chai-3. $400M Series C at $3.8B (Jul 2026). ~$630M total raised. Backed by Index, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, OpenAI.

deals.headline: 5-year licence
deals.summary: 5-year K Pro licence for research, target evaluation, clinical decisions, and CI.
deals.signal: Two major pharma licensing same platform within weeks: strong validation.
deals.platform_about: French AI biotech. K Pro agentic AI Scientist platform.

deals.headline: Org-wide
deals.summary: Org-wide BoltzMol-1 and BoltzProt-1 deployment with API integration and fine-tuning.
deals.signal: Some pharma prefer infrastructure they can customise and control.
deals.platform_about: Public benefit corp. Open-source biomolecular AI models.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Boltz foundation models, Lab/API, and LLM agent workflows across GSK's discovery pipeline.
deals.signal: Third top-20 pharma deal in six months. LLM agents for natural-language workflows.
deals.platform_about: Boltz Lab, API, and LLM agent workflows.

deals.headline: $1.7B+ + royalties
deals.summary: AI platform and wet lab for small molecule programs in oncology, GI, inflammation. Broader NeuralPLexer access.
deals.signal: Takeda assembling one of the most diversified AI discovery portfolios in pharma.
deals.platform_about: Clinical-stage. NeuralPLexer + Enchant with automated wet lab.

deals.headline: Up to $2.25B
deals.summary: AI-designed site-specific recombinases for genetic medicine. Lilly gets exclusive worldwide rights.
deals.signal: Generative AI designing entirely new therapeutic proteins for kilobase-scale DNA editing.
deals.platform_about: Protein language models for novel recombinases. $106M from Altimeter, Bezos.

deals.headline: $40M up, $1.4B+
deals.summary: Second collaboration expanding AI-driven Allo-Glue platform for molecular glue drugs.
deals.signal: Novartis returning to a 2020 partner — repeat deal signals delivered value.
deals.platform_about: Clinical-stage. Proximity-induced therapeutics with AI-driven molecular glue design.

deals.headline: $18M up, $2.5B+
deals.summary: AI drug discovery for neuroimmune CNS disorders. Insilico's largest APAC partnership.
deals.signal: Insilico's deal velocity: Lilly ($2.75B), SK ($2.5B), Takeda (~$600M) in four months.
deals.platform_about: Generative AI drug discovery (HKEX: 3696). Pharma.AI platform.

deals.headline: Upfront + miles + royalties
deals.summary: AI platform for novel drug entry points and small molecules against hard-to-drug targets.
deals.signal: Second major pharma deal (after Takeda $1.7B) validates Iambic's positioning.
deals.platform_about: NeuralPLexer and Enchant with automated wet lab.

deals.headline: $60M up, ~$600M+
deals.summary: Pharma.AI to discover clinically differentiated candidates across Takeda's therapeutic areas.
deals.signal: Takeda's CSO: transitioning to 'AI-native discovery model.' Insilico's 4th major deal in 18 months.
deals.platform_about: End-to-end Pharma.AI platform (HKEX: 3696).

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Novartis gains access to Chai-3 and AI design models for therapeutic antibody discovery across multiple targets. Builds on 1+ year of technical engagement.
deals.signal: Chai now partnered with Pfizer, Lilly, and Novartis — three of the top five pharma companies. Foundation model access plus proprietary deployment across antibody programmes.
deals.platform_about: AI company building a computer-aided design suite for molecules. Developer of Chai-3. Raised $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation (Jul 2026) led by Index Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia. ~$630M total raised.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: argenx gains access to Chai's Chai-3 platform for de novo antibody discovery across immunology targets, extending its antibody-engineering expertise with AI.
deals.signal: Chai's fourth pharma partnership in ~7 months (after Lilly, Pfizer, Novartis), landing one day after its $400M Series C. Immunology-focused de novo antibody design.
deals.platform_about: AI company building a computer-aided design suite for molecules. Developer of Chai-3. Founded 2024. Raised $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation (Jul 2026). ~$630M total raised. Also partnered with Pfizer, Lilly, Novartis and BMS.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: BMS integrates Chai's molecular folding and generative antibody-design models across its discovery portfolio to build an AI-driven, continuously-learning discovery system.
deals.signal: Chai now partnered with BMS, Pfizer, Lilly, Novartis and argenx. De novo antibody design targeting undruggable epitopes, aiming to compress early discovery from months to weeks.
deals.platform_about: AI company building a computer-aided design suite for molecules. Developer of Chai-3. Founded 2024 by an ex-Meta FAIR/OpenAI/Stripe/Absci team. Raised $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation (Jul 2026). ~$630M total raised.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Novo to test Claude Science in specific R&D workflows and use Anthropic's frontier models for AI-driven software development.
deals.signal: Novo adds a second frontier-model vendor five months after OpenAI: the multi-vendor strategy now reaches R&D reasoning itself.
deals.platform_about: Frontier AI lab. Claude models and the Claude Science workbench for research workflows.

deals.headline: Undisclosed; milestones + royalties
deals.summary: Multi-year collaboration on small molecules across immunology, neuroscience and oncology, using Iambic's Enchant v3 model.
deals.signal: Third major pharma deal in 2026 after Takeda and Bayer: Iambic is becoming a default small-molecule AI partner.
deals.platform_about: Clinical-stage. NeuralPLexer + Enchant with automated wet lab.

deals.headline: $1B+ in milestones
deals.summary: Multi-year research collaboration and option to validate tumour-specific RNA-splicing targets for solid tumours, using the SpliceCore platform.
deals.signal: AI target discovery moving into RNA splicing: pharma paying for new target classes, not just faster chemistry.
deals.platform_about: AI-driven biotech. SpliceCore screens 14M+ RNA splicing events to find disease-specific targets.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: GSK gains access to Chai's platform, including its protein folding and design models, across its discovery pipeline. Signed after GSK's own wet-lab evaluation, which found binders to all tested targets.
deals.signal: Chai's sixth pharma partner in nine months, and GSK's third foundation-model vendor in 2026 after Noetik and Boltz. Pharma is buying several external models and running them beside its own.
deals.platform_about: AI company building a computer-aided design suite for molecules. Developer of Chai-3. Founded 2024. Raised $400M Series C at $3.8B valuation (Jul 2026). Also partnered with Pfizer, Lilly, Novartis, argenx and BMS.

deals.headline: $144M received, $300M+ more
deals.summary: Sanofi optioned the first development candidate from the two companies' multi-program research collaboration: a potential first-in-class oral small molecule against a dual target in inflammatory disease. Phase 1 is planned for 2027.
deals.signal: Payment for a molecule a pharma chose to develop, not for platform access. Recursion's second pharma co-develop partner in the tracker, after Roche / Genentech.
deals.platform_about: Clinical-stage TechBio. Recursion OS combines automated biology, chemistry, and ML.

deals.headline: $55M up, $1.5B+
deals.summary: Research collaboration on multiple bispecific antibody programs in oncology. Earendil leads discovery through early clinical development on pre-agreed target pairs. Genentech then takes global development and commercialisation.
deals.signal: Earendil's second big pharma deal of 2026, after Sanofi in January. The same AI biologics platform now sells into oncology as well as immunology.
deals.platform_about: AI-powered biotech focused on next-generation biologics.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Licence for Owkin's K Pro AI Scientist and multimodal oncology data. Owkin will also generate new multimodal data in immunology. Builds on a 2025 pilot.
deals.signal: Owkin's third AI Scientist licence with a top pharma in the tracker in four months, after AstraZeneca (May) and Sanofi (June). Boehringer moved from a pilot to a licence.
deals.platform_about: French AI biotech. K Pro agentic AI Scientist platform.

deals.headline: $30M up, ~$1.2B milestones
deals.summary: Joint design and development of multispecific protein therapeutics for obesity and other metabolic diseases, using Generate's generative AI platform. Two initial programs with an option to add a third. $30M upfront, up to $35M in early preclinical milestones and nearly $1.2B in total milestones.
deals.signal: Obesity is the first indication. Pharma is commissioning AI-designed proteins for it, not only licensing finished assets.
deals.platform_about: Generative AI company designing protein therapeutics.

deals.headline: $40M up, $1.46B milestones
deals.summary: Strategic collaboration to identify new drug targets and advance new therapeutics for MASH and cardiomyopathies. $40M upfront and up to about $1.46B in discovery, development and commercial milestones, plus tiered royalties.
deals.signal: AstraZeneca's third AI deal in the tracker, after Modella and Owkin. Each buys a different layer: a company, a research agent, and now target discovery in liver and heart disease.
deals.platform_about: AI-driven drug discovery company.

deals.headline: Low double-digit $M up, ~$1.1B
deals.summary: Strategic collaboration on tissue-specific lipid nanoparticle delivery technologies. Upfront in the low double-digit millions of dollars and up to about $1.1B in milestones.
deals.signal: Lilly's seventh AI deal in the tracker, and a delivery deal, not a molecule deal. AI is being pointed at how a drug reaches its tissue.
deals.platform_about: AI-powered drug delivery company, listed in Hong Kong (7666.HK).

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: BMS deploys the Boltz platform and custom-built models on its own NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD compute, widening researcher access to biomolecular AI.
deals.signal: Boltz's fourth pharma partner in the tracker, after Pfizer, Takeda and GSK. BMS scientists were already using the open-source models before the agreement.
deals.platform_about: Applied AI research lab building open biomolecular models. Also partnered with Pfizer, Takeda and GSK.

deals.headline: $400M+ upfront and milestones
deals.summary: AI Proteins designs de novo miniproteins against targets selected by Astellas. Astellas holds an exclusive worldwide licence to the candidates. Over $400M in upfront and milestone payments, plus royalties.
deals.signal: First Astellas deal in the tracker. AI-designed miniproteins join antibodies and small molecules as a target class.
deals.platform_about: AI company designing de novo miniprotein therapeutics.

deals.headline: Up to $349M
deals.summary: Variational AI designs and optimises small molecule candidates against two undisclosed targets. Merck develops and commercialises the compounds. Upfront payment plus milestones, total potential up to $349M.
deals.signal: Third Merck / MSD deal in the tracker, after Google Cloud and Protillion. Two targets and a capped value: a test of a vendor, not a platform bet.
deals.platform_about: Generative AI drug discovery company based in Vancouver.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Roche will use Chai's AI models and platform in a number of drug discovery programs across its therapeutic areas.
deals.signal: Chai's seventh pharma partner, after Pfizer, Lilly, Novartis, argenx, BMS and GSK. Roche now sits in the tracker with Recursion, NVIDIA, Earendil and Chai.
deals.platform_about: AI company building a computer-aided design suite for molecules. Developer of Chai-3.

deals.headline: Upfront + milestones, undisclosed
deals.summary: XtalPi uses its AI and robotics platform to design novel small-molecule clinical candidates across several oncology programs, with dermatology and rare disease possible. Upfront, multiple milestones and downstream economic participation, none disclosed.
deals.signal: First French pharma and first XtalPi deal in the tracker, aimed at historically hard-to-drug oncology targets.
deals.platform_about: AI and robotics drug discovery company, listed in Hong Kong (2228.HK).

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: UCB will use Cradle's protein-design platform in selected discovery projects, from hit generation through lead optimisation to preclinical readiness.
deals.signal: Cradle's fifth pharma buyer in the tracker, after the four in its 2025-2026 platform row.
deals.platform_about: AI protein-design platform for antibodies and enzymes.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Agreement to deploy the Edison AI Platform and Kosmos, its AI scientist, across Pfizer's R&D pipeline, with Edison scientists and engineers working inside Pfizer research teams.
deals.signal: Edison's second pharma deployment in the tracker after Incyte (May 2026), and the first across a whole pipeline: oncology, internal medicine and immunology.
deals.platform_about: AI-scientist company. Kosmos runs research across literature and data.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: AbbVie will deploy Valkai's purpose-built AI across targeted areas of clinical research, part of its programme to embed AI across the enterprise.
deals.signal: A large pharma buying AI for clinical development, the thinnest part of the tracker: before this batch, 6 of 53 deals touched clinical development.
deals.platform_about: AI company building agentic tools for clinical development.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Deepcell and Gilead will co-develop a foundation model of CHO cell morphology, trained on Gilead's cell lines, to characterise the cell lines used to make biotherapeutics.
deals.signal: Gilead's first AI deal in the tracker, and a manufacturing one: before this batch, 5 of 53 deals touched manufacturing. The model is built on the pharma's own cell lines.
deals.platform_about: AI cell-imaging company.

deals.headline: $55M up, $2B+ milestones
deals.summary: Research collaboration and licence: Manifold designs multiple blood-brain-barrier shuttles for selected Roche payloads, and Roche takes them through preclinical, clinical and commercial development, with tiered royalties.
deals.signal: Roche paying for a delivery problem, not a target: getting biologics into the brain is the bottleneck for neurology.
deals.platform_about: AI-guided protein design company working on brain delivery.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Research collaboration to develop and evaluate AI solutions for preclinical toxicologic pathology.
deals.signal: AstraZeneca's fourth AI deal in the tracker, after Modella AI, OWKIN and insitro, and the first in preclinical safety.
deals.platform_about: AI company building foundation models for toxicologic pathology.

deals.headline: Undisclosed
deals.summary: Takeda deploys Weave's regulatory-writing platform across 14 active programmes in several markets, for IND drafting and health-authority questions.
deals.signal: Regulatory writing is one of the most measurable AI uses in development: Weave reports IND drafting time down 97% in one evaluated use case.
deals.platform_about: AI-native regulatory automation company.

deals.headline: 2-year enterprise agreement
deals.summary: Two-year enterprise agreement to deploy BenchSci's EMET across argenx's preclinical, computational and drug-development workflows, chosen after a competitive evaluation by argenx scientists.
deals.signal: BenchSci's third pharma agreement in a year, after Sanofi and Merck: evidence platforms bought on multi-year terms, not piloted.
deals.platform_about: Toronto AI company. Its platforms map preclinical evidence for disease biology research.

deals.headline: 3-year licence
deals.summary: Three-year licence to deploy ASCEND across Sanofi's global preclinical research organisation, for scientists and contractors at its sites worldwide.
deals.signal: Sanofi holds two AI research agent licences in the tracker: BenchSci (October 2025) and OWKIN (June 2026).
deals.platform_about: Toronto AI company. Its platforms map preclinical evidence for disease biology research.

deals.headline: 2-year renewal
deals.summary: Renewed two-year contract for ongoing access to ASCEND in preclinical disease biology and early discovery.
deals.signal: A renewal, not a new deal: the first record in the tracker of a pharma paying again after the first term.
deals.platform_about: Toronto AI company. Its platforms map preclinical evidence for disease biology research.

deals.headline: Up to $137.5M over 5 years
deals.summary: Tempus licenses oncology data and models directly to BMS for up to $137.5M over five years, disclosed in its Q3 2026 results. A separate $55M Alzheimer's data licence involves BMS and Pathos.
deals.signal: A public price for pharma's real-world data: a five-year ceiling for data and models, not a payment for molecules.
deals.platform_about: Precision-medicine and data company. Licenses de-identified clinical and molecular data to pharma.

deals.headline: Up to $400M + royalties
deals.summary: Research collaboration and option agreement on miniprotein therapeutics against two undisclosed targets: upfront cash, an expansion fee and milestones up to $400M, plus royalties.
deals.signal: AI Proteins' first big pharma deal. Astellas followed in October 2026 with a $400M+ licence (id 50).
deals.platform_about: AI company designing de novo miniprotein therapeutics.
